email.subject: Tide Group Hair Studio's site may be losing bookings
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I took a look at Tide Group Hair Studio's website. Two things stood out: your page title doesn't mention "salon" or "Harbor Falls," so you're likely invisible when people nearby search for a hair salon. And your homepage images are unoptimized, slowing load time enough that mobile visitors often leave before the page finishes loading.

Both are fixable without a redesign. I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes this kind of thing for a flat fee.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change? No pitch, just the findings.

Alex
